name: Mr. Brooks
source: Mr Brooks is the owner and operator of his own, very prestigious cafe, Brooks. Through his staunch business sense, tasty refreshments, and delicious, five-star French pastries made by his own Le Cordon Bleu graduate (Henri), Mr. Brooks managed to get the attention of national media, celebrities, and eventually the world. He is a dedicated man and a demanding boss, yet those who catch his eye are treated with utmost care. He's a passionate man always on the lookout for a new venture.
